content: Calem serves as the rival if the player chooses the female character, acting as a neighbor and close friend.
The manga counterpart X became a shut-in due to the pressure of being a child celebrity after winning a tournament.
Blue is described as a cocky and somewhat unfriendly young man whose primary motivation is to become the greatest Trainer.
Blue and Red were childhood friends, but Blue became mean as they grew older, viewing Red as his rival due to their similar age and height.
In the core games, Clair and Lance are cousins, but in the anime, their relationship is described as a mentor-student dynamic.
Dawn evolves from a girl walking in her mother's shadow to a confident Coordinator who relies on her own Pokémon's support.
In the animated series, the tower burned down 300 years prior due to a war for Ho-Oh's power, rather than 150 years prior due to lightning as in the games.
In the Golden Boys manga canon, the Burned Tower ruins were demolished and replaced by a stadium for the Pokémon Summit.
Blaine created Mewtwo using some of his own human cells, establishing a biological link that allows them to sense each other.
Blaine feels deep regret for his past actions with Team Rocket and strives to become a better person and scientist.
Agatha and Professor Oak were friendly rivals in their youth, but their relationship became strained after Oak stopped battling to create the Pokédex.
Agatha is described as having a very short temper and believes Pokémon should primarily be used for battling.
The name Alola is intended to represent a land overflowing with life force, potentially derived from Hawaiian and Latin roots meaning life, nurture, and share.
In the Pokémon Adventures manga, the Day-Care Couple were close friends with Professor Oak, Agatha, Kurt, and Pryce in their youth.
Despite its category name 'Legendary Pokémon', Arcanine is not an actual Legendary Pokémon.
Arcanine may be based on the Ryukyuan shisa, komainu, or the Chinese guardian lion.
Blaine is a highly intelligent man who enjoys riddles and puns, though he remains a stern and serious Gym Leader.
Blaine's decision to train Fire-type Pokémon was inspired by a Moltres that guided him out of a freezing mountain range.
Bruno teaches that the true secret behind Pokémon training is that Trainers and their Pokémon should care for each other.
While fans view him as a stoic individual dedicated to hard work, he also possesses a playful side and superhuman physical strength.

subtopic: relationship between Grand Oak and Professor Oak
content: Grand Oak resembles Professor Oak in name, appearance, and theme music, but their exact relationship is unknown.
Celio admits to having zero aptitude for battling.
Erika is a serene, ladylike woman and a teacher of flower-arranging who only collects Pokémon she considers attractive.
Brock is known for his rock-hard willpower and a serious demeanor, though he finds it hard to stop laughing once he starts.
In the animated series, Brock is obsessed with pretty girls and often gets rejected or pulled away.
In Paldea, Champion is a permanent honorary title that can be held by multiple Trainers simultaneously.
Deoxys can change between Normal, Attack, Defense, and Speed forms by interacting with certain meteorites.
Deoxys is the result of a mutation of an extraterrestrial virus caused by exposure to a laser beam.
Drew is confident and critical, often taunting May, but he provides help when she needs it and acknowledges her achievements.
In the manga, Drew is more flamboyant and arrogant than his anime counterpart and frequently breaks into dance.
Chase is the male player character in Let's Go, Pikachu! and Let's Go, Eevee!, serving as an analogue to Red from Generation I.
Dragonite is a kind-hearted Pokémon known as the sea guardian that rescues drowning humans and guides lost ships to safety.
Mega Evolution increases Dragonite's speed and strength but diminishes its naturally helpful and kind nature.
Hoothoot possesses a special internal organ that senses the world's rotation, allowing it to keep perfect track of time.
Hoothoot has been regarded as a divine messenger and a deity of wisdom in some countries.
Falkner's Hoothoot is observed standing on both legs, contradicting the general species trait of standing on only one leg.
Unlike the Orange Islands, the Decolore Islands have no known League or regional Professor.
The Decolore Islands is the only region where neither Ash nor any other main character caught a new Pokémon.
It is the only archipelago that does not include a villainous team.
Gladion initially appears rebellious and unfriendly, but cares deeply for his family and Pokémon.
Despite working as an enforcer, other Team Skull members do not consider Gladion a true member of the organization.
In the Adventures series, Giovanni is depicted as more directly ruthless than in the games, exemplified by his use of Cloyster to kill Magmar.
Giovanni views Pokémon as tools to be used for his criminal enterprise.
James grew up as a child of millionaires and felt constrained by the rules and standards of the upper-class.
Both James and Jessie received the lowest scores in the history of Pokémon Tech.
Johto is based on the real Kansai region in Japan, reflecting a harmony of contrasting cultures and a link to the past through historical architecture.
Green suffers from ornithophobia due to being kidnapped by Ho-Oh as a child, which she eventually overcomes in the Gold, Silver & Crystal arc.
Goh is driven by a childhood encounter with Mew, leading to his lifelong goal of catching the Mythical Pokémon and every other Pokémon.
Hau is described as a big-hearted, optimistic boy with a huge appetite for malasada.
Hau and Gladion have conflicting views on Pokémon battles, with Hau initially treating them as fun and Gladion taking them more seriously.
Lanette is implied to know Bill in Ruby, Sapphire, and Emerald, but this mention is removed in Omega Ruby and Alpha Sapphire.
Zarude is the only Pokémon in the Isle of Armor Pokédex that can be registered but is not required for completion.
The Isle of Armor Pokédex lists Shelmet and Accelgor before Karrablast and Escavalier, which is the reverse of all other Pokédex listings.
Lana and Mallow became best friends at a young age after an adventure in a forest where they met a Drampa.
In Generation II, Janine's team consists entirely of male Pokémon, whereas in HeartGold and SoulSilver, her team is all-female.
In the English version of FireRed and LeafGreen, Janine is mistranslated as 'Charine' in the Fame Checker.
The Sinnoh Pokédex varies by game version, with Platinum expanding the list to 210 Pokémon compared to 151 in Diamond and Pearl.
With the introduction of the Fairy type in Generation VI, the Clefairy family changed from pure Normal to pure Fairy.
Y overcomes her emotional distress regarding her mother after being taunted by Yvette.
In Pokémon Black and White, the Unova Pokédex was one of only two regional Pokédexes, along with Kanto, to contain Pokémon from only one generation.
The New Pokédex is a precursor to later regional Pokédexes, uniquely including all Pokémon from both Kanto and Johto.
Lillie begins as a shy, fearful girl who dislikes Pokémon battles but gradually gains confidence and becomes a Pokémon Trainer.
Lillie's original outfit, chosen by Lusamine, causes her to bear a resemblance to the Ultra Beast Nihilego.
Gyarados's design is inspired by the myth of a carp leaping over a waterfall to transform into a dragon.
Snorlax is known for its habit of blocking bridges in the Kanto and Kalos regions.
Nosepass is always oriented to face north.
Clefairy and Clefable perform lunar rituals by dancing under the full moon.
Lillie suffered from a crippling fear of touching Pokémon due to a childhood trauma involving Nihilego, which she eventually overcame through bonding with Snowy and Silvally.
Volo mentions two legends for Lake Valor's origin: one claiming it was a volcano crater and another claiming it was carved by an ancient Pokémon battle.
In the anime, Lake Valor is described as an entrance to another dimension where the lake guardians actually reside.
Spinarak was incorrectly listed as a pure Bug type until patch 1.0.2 on March 17, 2026.
Wooper is the only Pokémon in the Pokopia Pokédex that appears as a regional form.
Koga appreciates the despair and horror that Poison-type Pokémon can inflict on others.
Lorelei is characterized by a logical, calculated, and cool style of battling.
In the Pokémon Adventures manga, Lorelei is portrayed as a villainess who seeks to eliminate humans cruel to Pokémon.
In the anime, she is known as Prima and focuses on mentoring trainers to find their inner strength.
Mr. Game lives for the excitement of watching people play his Coin game.
Looker speaks with odd grammatical constructs in the English version of Platinum, suggesting he is not fluent in the regional language, though this is absent in the Japanese version.
It is strongly suggested in Pokémon X and Y that Looker's Pokémon was killed, potentially referring to his Croagunk.
Lt. Surge is portrayed as an arrogant, loud, and crude individual who looks down on unevolved Pokémon.
Lt. Surge used Electric-type Pokémon to power his planes while serving as a pilot.
Mintale Town is popularly believed to be in or near Kanto due to the appearance of Viridian Forest, though its location is never explicitly stated.
Mable expresses that her research for Team Flare may not have been for nothing after helping calm Xerneas.
Mable provides historical context on Xerneas as the Pokémon who gives life and Yveltal as the Pokémon who takes it.
The Magikarp salesman is a traveling con man who misleads customers to sell worthless Pokémon at high prices.
The definition of Mt. Silver varies between Generation II and HeartGold/SoulSilver, with the latter distinguishing between the outside area and the cave.
Mt. Pyre serves as a place where many graves of Pokémon are housed and where grieving Trainers visit to pay their respects.
Phoebe visits Mt. Pyre to pay her respects to her grandmother, who lived on the summit.
Bill complains that his father does not work and is a drain on the family, spending free time gambling.
New Island served as the site of Mewtwo's creation and later his fortress, also known as the Pokémon Palace or Temple of Mewtwo.
The name Pokélantis is a portmanteau of 'Pokémon' and 'Atlantis'.
The Trainer class name was changed from Gambler to Gamer in some English versions to avoid gambling references, and later to PI in others due to the trenchcoat association with detectives.
Joy is revealed to be the family name of the nurses rather than their first name.
The Old Man glitch in English Generation I games causes the appearance of MissingNo. and high-level Pokémon.
In Japanese versions, the old man is passed out drunk, whereas in Western versions, he is grumpy due to a lack of coffee.
The Johto Pokédex in HeartGold and SoulSilver contains 256 Pokémon, though only 254 are required for completion as Mew and Celebi are excluded.
The Pokémon Association handles legislation, pays Gym Leaders, and organizes League competitions in the Pokémon Adventures manga.
Pokémon Centers provide regulatory services for Trainers, most notably healing Pokémon free of charge.
Fans often view Rayquaza as the leader of the super-ancient Pokémon trio including Kyogre and Groudon.
One Island has a very small population because many young people move away to big cities in Kanto.
Green suffered trauma after being attacked by an invisible Pokémon and seeing her parents trapped in a black hole.
The nine core series regions are inspired by real-world geography and demographics from Japan, the United States, and Western Europe.
Agatha and Oak were childhood friends and top-class trainers, but Agatha felt betrayed when Oak stopped battling to invent the Pokédex.
According to Professor Elm and other NPCs, Pokémon Eggs are not strictly eggs but are more like Pokémon cradles.
In some animation and manga, an Egg's shell pattern reflects the appearance of the Pokémon inside.
It is unclear if real Pokémon exist in the region or if it is set in the same universe as other regions.
In Chuang Yi's English translation of the manga, the names of Ruby and Sapphire were switched, possibly to align with Pokémon Adventures.
Slowpoke is known for its dim intellect and slow response to stimuli, sometimes taking a day to notice its tail has been bitten.
Galarian Slowpoke's spicy tail and behavior are attributed to the buildup of Galarica particles from eating Galarica seeds.
Samson is a cheerful and zany individual who enjoys making puns with Pokémon names accompanied by visual impressions.
Junichi Masuda stated that Sinnoh's name is derived from 'mysterious and profound', referencing the region's myths.
Fans speculated a Mew was hiding under a truck in the harbor, but in FireRed and LeafGreen, a Lava Cookie is found there instead.
A rumor claimed the ship returns if the player enters the Hall of Fame 365 times, but this is untrue.
A message telling players to 'buy it or die' was a hoax hacked into a ROM and not part of the original game.
The Pokémon League serves as an umbrella organization that oversees various regional Leagues and organizes competitions for registered Trainers.
In the Pokémon Adventures manga, the Pokémon League is sanctioned and run by the Pokémon Association, and the Elite Four are not always sanctioned by the League.
Ash views his Pokémon as partners and friends rather than just tools for battle.
Ruby initially believes appearances are everything and views battling as barbaric, but eventually learns that beauty is not solely based on outward appearances.
Sapphire initially disliked the beautification of Pokémon, preferring their natural state, but eventually learned to appreciate beauty.
There is disagreement between the Pokédex, Unown Report, and Professor Oak on whether Unown communicate via electromagnetic radio waves or telepathy.
It is a mystery whether Unown predates or postdates written language and hieroglyphs.
In the movie Spell of the Unown: Entei, Unown is referred to as a Legendary Pokémon and possesses power matching such creatures.
Lillie views Professor Kukui and Professor Burnet as father and mother-like figures, though she is turned off by Kukui's shirtless appearance.
Whitney is described as a sweet but ditzy young lady who easily gets lost in her hometown.
Whitney's battle strategy relies on the increasing strength of Miltank's Rollout and Clefairy's unpredictable Metronome.
The Unova region is geographically and socially inspired by the New York City metropolitan area and the state of New York.
There are conflicting legends regarding Kyurem: one claims it is an extraterrestrial that arrived via meteor, while another claims it is the remnant of the original dragon.
Snowpoint City is named after the Snowpoint Temple, not the other way around.
In Pokémon Platinum, Regigigas is one of the lowest leveled wild Pokémon in the game.
Vivian and Lilian are sisters who share the same occupation and look similar, but possess drastically different personalities.
Ultima is the guardian of ultimate moves and requires trainers to complete the Path of Skipping, Catching, and Battling to learn them.
Villainous teams are typically organized crime groups that misuse Pokémon to achieve their goals.
Trip initially looked down on Ash due to his origin in Kanto, but after being humbled by Alder, he became more friendly and eventually became friends with Ash.
